title: Keep CI tool versions up to date with the GitLab Renovate bot
description:
## Summary

Every tool version used by the chart's CI pipeline is pinned by hand in `.gitlab-ci.yml` (`ALPINE_IMAGE_TAG`, `DOCKER_VERSION`, `HELM_VERSION`, `HELM_UNITTEST_PLUGIN_VERSION`, `KIND_VERSION`, `KUBECTL_VERSION`). The last bump before #602 was !421 in August 2023, after which several of them went end-of-life unnoticed.

## Proposal

Onboard this project to the GitLab Renovate bot, https://gitlab.com/orbit/frontend/renovate-gitlab-bot, the same way `orbit/orbit`, `orbit/gl-openshift/orbit-operator` and `orbit/team/gitlab` are handled. The bot then opens an MR whenever one of these tools publishes a new release.

Following the bot's [setup process](https://gitlab.com/orbit/frontend/renovate-gitlab-bot/-/blob/main/docs/setting-up-a-new-project.md), this needs two MRs in the bot repository:

1. Add `{ path = "orbit/team/orbit", fork_path = "charts-gitlab-runner" }` to `forks/config.tfvars` (the bot maintains a mirror fork under `gitlab-renovate-forks`).
2. Add `renovate/projects/charts-gitlab-runner.config.js` with a `custom.regex` manager per CI variable:
   - `ALPINE_IMAGE_TAG` → docker `alpine`
   - `DOCKER_VERSION` → docker `docker`
   - `HELM_VERSION` → docker `alpine/helm`
   - `HELM_UNITTEST_PLUGIN_VERSION` → github-releases `helm-unittest/helm-unittest`
   - `KIND_VERSION` → github-releases `kubernetes-sigs/kind`
   - `KUBECTL_VERSION` → github-tags `kubernetes/kubernetes`

   with `kind` and `kubectl` grouped into one MR, default labels (`maintenance::dependency`, `type::maintenance`), reviewers from the `runner-helm` roulette project and `semanticCommits: "disabled"`.

## Notes

- The Renovate fork has no `AUTHENTICATION_TOKEN`, so the `integration test *` jobs cannot run there. Reviewers have to run the MR pipeline from the canonical project; the MR template note should say so, as `charts/gitlab` does.
- Depends on #602 / !564, which moves all versions into CI variables so that the regex managers can find them.
